items.docs: Install an integration for a specific group. The group must already have a SaaS connection — either provide its `connectionId`, or omit it to use the group's default. To create a connection, use the [OAuth Connect endpoint](https://docs.withampersand.com/reference/oauth/generate-oauth-authorization-url) or the [prebuilt UI components](https://docs.withampersand.com/embeddable-ui-components).

items.docs: Update an installation using field masks. Note: subscribe config changes trigger a subscription change in the provider's system, which typically takes 1-2 minutes but may take up to 10 minutes.

items.docs: Delete an Installation. This will also delete the associated Connection if it is not used by any other Installations.

params.name: objectName
params.description:
The object name whose config content will be patched.
Must match an object name defined in the integration's manifest for the specified action type (read, subscribe, or write).
Common examples include: `account`, `contact`, `lead`, `opportunity` (for Salesforce), `deal`, `company` (for HubSpot), etc.

items.docs: Updates a single object's configuration within an installation using JSON Patch syntax.
